parsed.explanation: Worst documented feature is state-tolerated/directed targeting (precedence tier 2): section 35(c) 'shadow law' detention used specifically against transgender people (qualitatively 'frequently'), documented stripping, beating and 14-day detention of trans women, and post-coup torture/sexual violence in detention with LGBTIQ+ killings recorded (raw counts, magnitude unresolved). Section 377 is enforced and intensified post-2021 as an aggravating factor alongside arbitrary detention and vague decency laws. Severity after discovery reaches imprisonment (up to years/life), custody torture and killing; recourse is absent (no anti-discrimination law, 50% surveyed report no legal-system confidence, though field period unstated). Positives — a 2020 poll showing majority acceptance, nat kadaw visibility — are social climate signals that do not offset operative state exposure. No LGR is a resident gap, not counted directly. State's own hand in the documented abuse puts this at the severe/high boundary.
